G1: Α, α, ἄλφα (which see), τό, indecl., alpha, the first letter of the Greek alphabet. As a numeral, ά = 1, α = 1000. As a prefix, it appears to have at least two and perhaps three distinct senses: 1. ἀ- (before a vowel, ἀν-) negative, as in ἄ-γνωστος, ἄ-δικος. 2. ἀ-, ἁ- copulative, indicating community and fellowship, as in ἁ-πλοῦς, ἀ-κολουθέω, ἀ-δελφός. 3. An intensive force (LS, s. α), as in ἀ-τενίζω is sometimes assumed (but see Boisacq, see word). (AS)

G3361: μή, subjective negative particle, used where the negation depends on a condition or hypothesis, expressed or understood, as distinct from οὐ, which denies absolutely. μή is used where one thinks a thing is not, as distinct from an absolute negation. As a general rule, οὐ negatives the indic, μή the other moods, incl, ptcp. [In LXX for אֵין ,אַיִן ,אַל ] I. As a neg. adv., not; 1. with ref. to thought or opinion: ⟦42.3.18⟧, ⟦55.1.11⟧, ⟦60.1.9⟧. 2. In delib. questions, with subjc. (M, Pr., 185): ⟦40.12.14⟧, ⟦44.3.8⟧. 3. In conditional and final sentences, after εἰ, ἐάν, ἄν, ἵνα, ὅπως: ⟦39.10.14⟧, ⟦40.6.11⟧ ⟦40.12.19⟧, ⟦41.9.5⟧, ⟦42.6.50⟧, ⟦44.11.25⟧, al. 4. C. inf. (see M, Pr., 234f., 239, 255), (a) after verbs of saying, etc.: ⟦39.2.12⟧ ⟦39.5.34⟧, ⟦40.12.18⟧, ⟦43.15.38⟧, ⟦44.2.21⟧, al.; (b) with artic. inf.: after a prep., ⟦39.13.5⟧, ⟦40.4.5⟧, ⟦43.7.19⟧, ⟦45.10.6⟧, al.; without a prep., ⟦44.14.13⟧, ⟦46.2.1⟧ ⟦46.2.13⟧ ⟦51.4.6⟧; (with) in sentences expressing consequence, after ὥστε: ⟦39.8.28⟧, ⟦40.3.20⟧, ⟦45.1.7⟧, ⟦46.3.7⟧, al. 5. C. ptcp. (see M, Pr., 231f., 239), in hypothetical references to persons of a certain character or description: ⟦39.10.28⟧ ⟦39.12.30⟧, ⟦41.6.49⟧, ⟦42.3.18⟧, ⟦44.4.5⟧, ⟦45.7.38⟧, ⟦61.3.10⟧, al.; where the person or thing being definite, the denial is a matter of opinion: ⟦42.6.64⟧, ⟦45.1.28⟧ ⟦45.4.7⟧ ⟦45.4.18⟧, ⟦46.5.21⟧, al.; where the ptcp. has a concessive, causal or conditional force, if, though, because not: ⟦39.18.25⟧, ⟦41.2.45⟧, ⟦42.7.49⟧, ⟦43.9.26⟧, ⟦44.2.14⟧ ⟦44.5.13⟧, ⟦46.3.14⟧, ⟦47.6.9⟧, Ju 5; where the ptcp. has a descriptive force (being such as), not: ⟦43.9.9⟧, ⟦44.1.28⟧, ⟦45.10.33⟧, ⟦47.4.8⟧, ⟦57.12.27⟧, al. 6. μή prohibitive, in indep. sentences, (a) with subjc. praes., 1 of person(s) pl.: ⟦47.5.26⟧ ⟦47.6.9⟧, ⟦51.5.6⟧, ⟦61.3.18⟧; (b) with imperat. praes., usually where one is bidden to desist from what has already begun (cf. M, Pr., 122ff.): ⟦39.7.1⟧, ⟦40.5.36⟧, ⟦41.6.30⟧, ⟦42.2.16⟧ ⟦42.5.45⟧, ⟦43.10.15⟧, ⟦44.11.18⟧, ⟦58.2.1⟧, ⟦65.5.5⟧, al.; (with) forbidding that which is still future: with imperat. aor., 3 of person(s), ⟦39.24.18⟧, ⟦40.13.15⟧, ⟦41.17.31⟧, al.; with subjc. aor., 2 of person(s), ⟦39.3.9⟧ ⟦39.10.26⟧, ⟦40.5.7⟧, ⟦41.6.29⟧, ⟦42.3.7⟧, ⟦44.10.6⟧, al.; (d) with optative, in wishes: ⟦54.4.16⟧ (LXX); μὴ γένοιτο (see M, Pr., 194; Bl., §66, 1), ⟦41.20.16⟧, ⟦44.3.3⟧, al.; μή τις, ⟦40.13.5⟧, al. II. As a conj., 1. after verbs of fearing, caution, etc., that, lest, perhaps (M, Pr., 192f.): with subjc. praes., ⟦57.12.15⟧ with subjc. aor., ⟦39.24.4⟧, ⟦40.13.5⟧, ⟦41.21.8⟧, ⟦43.13.40⟧, ⟦47.5.15⟧, al.; ὅρα μή (see M, Pr., 124, 178), elliptically, ⟦65.19.10⟧ ⟦65.22.9⟧; with indic, fut. IV. οὐ μή as emphatic negation (cf. M, Pr., 188, 190ff.; Bl. §64, 5), not at all, by no means: with indic, fut., ⟦39.16.22⟧, ⟦42.6.35⟧, ⟦57.10.17⟧, al.; with subjc. aor., ⟦39.24.2⟧, ⟦40.13.2⟧, ⟦41.6.37⟧, ⟦42.13.8⟧, ⟦45.8.13⟧, al. (AS)
